import json, os, pathlib, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts')
import planning_stats as P
import ledger as L
N, T = chr(10), chr(9)
O = lambda v: {'value': v, 'source': 'observed'}
U = {'value': None, 'source': 'unknown'}
def led(i, **extra):
    row = {'schema_version': 2, 'run_id': 'r%d' % i, 'tokens_input': O(100 * (i + 1)), 'tokens_output': O(10), 'tokens_cache': O(1000), 'tokens_reasoning': O(99999), 'subagents': {'calls': O(1), 'tokens': O(50 * (i + 1))}, 'outcome': 'completed', 'failure_class': None}
    row.update(extra)
    return row
plan = {'type': 'architect-run', 'plan': 'P', 'seat': 's', 'model': 'm', 'input_tokens': 5000, 'output_tokens': 0, 'cache_read_tokens': 0, 'thinking_tokens': 777, 'subagent_stats': {'spawned': 0}, 'outcome': 'blocked'}
rows = [led(i) for i in range(9)] + [led(0), plan, {'type': 'review', 'run_id': 'r1', 'input_tokens': 1, 'output_tokens': 1, 'cache_read_tokens': 1}, led(20, outcome='failed'), led(21, failure_class='environment'), led(22, tokens_cache=U), led(23, subagents={'calls': U, 'tokens': U})]
tmp = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
data = tmp / 'data.jsonl'
data.write_text(N.join(json.dumps(r) for r in rows) + N + '[1, 2]' + N, encoding='utf-8')
def batch(name, ids):
    path = tmp / (name + '.json')
    path.write_text(json.dumps({'name': name, 'run_ids': ids}), encoding='utf-8')
    return path
ten = ['r%d' % i for i in range(9)] + ['plan:P']
got = P.batch_summary(batch('before', ten), data)
assert got == {'batch': 'before', 'runs': 10, 'median_parent_total': 1560, 'median_parent_plus_subagent_total': 1835, 'median_subagent_calls': 1, 'done': 9}, got
unk = P.batch_summary(batch('unk', ten[:8] + ['r23', 'plan:P']), data)
assert (unk['median_parent_total'], unk['median_parent_plus_subagent_total'], unk['median_subagent_calls']) == (1560, None, None), unk
env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1')
cli = lambda *a: subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'scripts/planning_stats.py', *a], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
out = cli('batch', str(batch('before', ten)), str(data))
table = N.join(T.join(c) for c in (['batch', 'before'], ['runs', '10'], ['median_parent_total', '1560'], ['median_parent_plus_subagent_total', '1835'], ['median_subagent_calls', '1'], ['done_rate', '9/10'])) + N
assert (out.returncode, out.stdout, out.stderr) == (0, table, ''), out
out = cli('batch', str(batch('unk', ten[:8] + ['r23', 'plan:P'])), str(data))
assert out.returncode == 0 and (T + 'unknown' + N) in out.stdout, out
for name, ids in (('nine', ten[:9]), ('dup', ten[:9] + ['r0']), ('missing', ten[:9] + ['nope']), ('failed', ten[:9] + ['r20']), ('env', ten[:9] + ['r21']), ('unmeasured', ten[:9] + ['r22'])):
    out = cli('batch', str(batch(name, ids)), str(data))
    assert out.returncode == 2 and out.stdout == '' and out.stderr.startswith('planning_stats: '), (name, out)
shutil.rmtree(tmp)
real = P.summarize('tests/fixtures/planning-stats/2a-baseline-routing-data.jsonl')
assert (real['all'], real['duplicates'], real['unmeasured']) == ({'runs': 36, 'median_total': 1250599}, 3, 2), real
FORMAT = '{"name": "<batch name>", "run_ids": ["<run id>", ...]}'
USAGE = 'python3 scripts/planning_stats.py batch <batch.json> <data.jsonl>'
doc = P.__doc__ or ''
missing = [s for s in (FORMAT, USAGE, 'python3 scripts/planning_stats.py <routing-data.jsonl>', 'at least 10', 'schema_version 2', 'plan:<plan>', 'done_rate', 'never parsed') if s not in doc]
assert not missing, ('docstring', missing)
for name in ('scripts/planning_stats.py', 'tests/test-planning-stats.py'):
    assert '20261014-2a-foundation' not in pathlib.Path(name).read_text(encoding='utf-8'), name + ' names the live 2A directory'
readme = pathlib.Path('tests/fixtures/planning-stats/README.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
NEW = 'ghp-/github-pat-'
missing = [s for s in (FORMAT, USAGE, '2a-baseline-routing-data.jsonl', '06481fd', NEW, '745971d', 'Never refresh', 'plan:<plan>') if s not in readme]
assert not missing, ('README', missing)
lines = readme.splitlines()
assert len(lines) <= 40 and NEW.replace('-', '_') not in readme, 'README is too long or carries the unscrubbed marker'
assert not [n for n, t in enumerate(lines, 1) if L.EMAIL.search(t) or L.ABSOLUTE_PATH.search(t) or any(p.search(t) for p in L.SECRET_PATTERNS)], 'README trips a ledger privacy pattern'
assert 'def test_docs_describe_the_batch_format_and_frozen_fixtures' in pathlib.Path('tests/test-planning-stats.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8'), 'docs test missing'
manifest = json.load(open('harness-manifest.json', encoding='utf-8'))['ownership']
assert [manifest[key].count('scripts/planning_stats.py') for key in ('install_payload_paths', 'update_paths')] == [1, 1], 'manifest'
print('ok')
